events.name: RC RACING
events.description: RC Robo Racing is a wireless robot car competition featuring challenging off-road tracks with mud, gravel, slopes, water, and other obstacles. Teams compete through lanockout rounds, with the top B advancing to individual final time trials. Performance is judged on speed, robustness, design, and safety, with penalties for rule violations.

events.name: Robowars_8kg
events.description: RoboWars: The Ultimate Showdown of Battle Bots! Watch as cutting-edge robots clash in a high-tech arena, combining engineering brilliance with thrilling combat. Who will reign supreme in this epic fight for robotic dominance?

events.name: Death Race
events.description: Death Race is a high-intensity robotics challenge that tests a bot's power, agility, speed, and precisio as it navigates a maze of intricate obstacles. Participants must demonstrate innovative design, strategic control, and engineering excellence to overcome challenging twists and turns.

events.name: Robo Soccer
events.description: An ultimate test of strategy, robotics, and engineering design, where human ingenuity meets machine precision in fast-paced, high-energy matches. Put your skills to the field, outplay the competition, and battle for exciting prizes worth ₹20,000. Let's see whose bot earns the Golden Boot!

events.name: Line Follower
events.description: Get ready to unleash your creativity and engineeringprowess at the Line Follower Robot Competition! Design and build swift, autonomous robots to navigate a challenging track using advanced sensors and programming. It's a thrilling race of innovation and precision.

events.name: Aero Sprint
events.description: Take your piloting skills to new heights in the ultimatedrone showdown! Navigate challenging obstacle courses, dodge tricky hurdles, and outmaneuver the competition across multiple rounds designed to test precision, strategy, and control. Keep your drone steady, because one wrong move and it's game over!

events.name: Aquarush
events.description: Set sail for Aqua Rush, where speed, power, and agility meet a sea of challenging obstacles! Navigate the waters, tackle every twist, and keep your boat afloat, because this race is all about engineering, strategy, and a little bit of controlled chaos. Let's sea who earns the title of Titan of the Seas!
